rows.label: ERCOT coincident peak load
rows.at: the month's 4CP interval, June to September
rows.basis: ERCOT's load in the 15-minute interval it names as the month's coincident peak, June to September; a transmission customer's share of the four sets its transmission charge for the next year. One value a summer month, dated the month: the row holds four months a year.

rows.label: ERCOT hub average, real time
rows.at: at the month's 4CP interval, June to September
rows.basis: The hub average's 15-minute real-time price in the interval ERCOT names as the month's coincident peak (the interval of the row above), June to September, dated the month: what energy cost in the interval that also sets a load's transmission charge.

rows.label: Texas delivery charges, by utility
rows.note: The Texas delivery charges the ERW holds (texas_delivery_charges) were read by a model from five news outlets' reports and are internal. Source that would supply them openly: each transmission and distribution utility's tariff, as the Public Utility Commission of Texas posts it.
